tasks.title: Phosphate (calcium superphosphate)
tasks.why: Goes into the soil during land preparation, before the last ploughing.
tasks.source: Ministry of Agriculture / ARC wheat bulletin (timing); amount from the Ministry's recommended rates (MALR)
tasks.amount: About 100–120 kg of calcium superphosphate 15.5% per feddan (2 bags). For your 3 feddan: about 330 kg. Check the amount with your engineer.

tasks.title: Sow by 15 Oct
tasks.why: Bezra starts the water plan from sowing day.
tasks.source: You
tasks.amount: About 60 kg of seed per feddan (about 45 kg on raised beds)

tasks.title: Nitrogen, 1st dose (urea or ammonium nitrate)
tasks.why: Before the first water turn (the mohayah), so the water carries it to the roots.
tasks.source: Ministry of Agriculture / ARC wheat bulletin (timing); amount from the Ministry's recommended rates (MALR)
tasks.amount: About 75–85 kg of urea 46% per feddan (1.5 bags). For your 3 feddan: about 240 kg. Check the amount with your engineer.

tasks.amount: About 75–85 kg of urea 46% per feddan (1.5 bags). For your 3 feddan: about 240 kg. Check the amount with your engineer.
